editorial.thesis: A learning-and-food-and-drink city of about 283,000. Its retail is heavy on coaching & training and cafés, tea & coffee, and thin on apparel, footwear & jewellery and pharmacy & health retail — and 44% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is ahead of Ahmedabad. 19.1 chain outlets per lakh residents against 14.34 in Ahmedabad; 22 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Apollo Pharmacy 9, Domino's 6, Bata 6.

The mapped economy leans to education. Shares of all mapped places: education 12.9% (Ahmedabad 7.5%); desserts & sweets 0.9% (Ahmedabad 0.8%); shops & retail 10.4% (Ahmedabad 14.7%); offices 14.4% (Ahmedabad 18.7%). Raw counts would mislead because Ahmedabad is mapped more completely (54,281 places against 4,373), so we compare mix, not counts.

Supply and demand are misaligned. 5 zones hold 44% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Gandhinagar · Gh Road alone has about 40,000 residents and 34 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is more concentrated than in Ahmedabad. 52% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Ahmedabad 46%). The largest cores are Adalaj (651 places) and Gandhinagar · Nr. Reliance Cross Road (242).

The widest brand gaps against Ahmedabad. Apollo Pharmacy 9 outlets vs 83; Café Coffee Day 2 outlets vs 46; Domino's 6 outlets vs 45. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 6 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Ahmedabad, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Gandhinagar · Gh Road and Gandhinagar · Randesan Road are the largest zones by residents (40,000 and 28,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 52% of all commercial places, and Adalaj alone lists 651.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Adalaj holds 24 of the 54 tracked chain outlets, and Gandhinagar · Chh Road adds 7.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Adalaj and Gandhinagar · Gh Road lead on education places (80 and 66, with 24 and 20 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Gandhinagar · Gh Road and Gandhinagar · Gh Road. The blue cores include Adalaj.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (54,281 places in Ahmedabad against 4,373 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Ahmedabad; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar's mapped places over-index on education (12.9% vs 7.5%), desserts & sweets (0.9% vs 0.8%), food & beverage (7.4% vs 6.3%) and under-index on shops & retail (10.4% vs 14.7%), offices (14.4% vs 18.7%), services & crafts (5.9% vs 7.2%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 54 outlets of 22 tracked national brands within 6 km — 19.1 per lakh residents against Ahmedabad's 14.34 (624 outlets of 38 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Ahmedabad are Apollo Pharmacy (9 vs 83); Café Coffee Day (2 vs 46); Domino's (6 vs 45). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Ahmedabad's, so low means thin by Ahmedabad's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 6 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Gandhinagar's age mix against Ahmedabad: children (0–14) 24.6% vs 23.9%, 15–24 19.5% vs 19.3%, working age 48.1% vs 48.8%, 60+ 7.9% vs 8.0%. Under-25s are 44% of residents.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 5.2% of mapped places against 4.4% in Ahmedabad — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 6 (Ahmedabad 45), Subway 3 (Ahmedabad 34), KFC 2 (Ahmedabad 11), McDonald's 1 (Ahmedabad 27). No mapped outlet in either city: Haldiram's, Biryani By Kilo, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.3% of mapped places against 1.8% in Ahmedabad — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Starbucks 2 (Ahmedabad 11), Café Coffee Day 2 (Ahmedabad 46). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Blue Tokai, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.9% of mapped places against 0.8% in Ahmedabad — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Havmor 2 (Ahmedabad 35). No mapped outlet in either city: Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.1% of mapped places against 1.2% in Ahmedabad — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 3 (Ahmedabad 28), DMart 2 (Ahmedabad 13). No mapped outlet in either city: More, Vishal Mega Mart.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 0.5% of mapped places against 0.6% in Ahmedabad — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 9 (Ahmedabad 83). No mapped outlet in either city: Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 3.5% of mapped places against 5.5% in Ahmedabad — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Bata 6 (Ahmedabad 29), Raymond 4 (Ahmedabad 34), Westside 1 (Ahmedabad 9), Pantaloons 1 (Ahmedabad 9).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 7.3% of mapped places against 8.1% in Ahmedabad, so the mix is level.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 3.8% of mapped places against 2.3% in Ahmedabad — above its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 3.8% of mapped places against 3.8% in Ahmedabad, so the mix is level.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
